$comment: Build-time placeholders. The container entrypoint substitutes __OWV_SERVER__ / __OWV_PORT__ / __OWV_MEDIA_PORT__ from SIGNALING_SERVER / SIGNALING_PORT / MEDIA_PORT (env or /etc/host.yaml) on every boot. MEDIA_PORT is optional: unset renders to null and the library negotiates media via SDP. For `npm run dev` (no entrypoint) override at runtime: ?server=<ip>&port=<port>&media=<port>.
